title: Saudi Arabia Launches Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition

blocks.content: Saudi Arabia has launched the Multinational Maritime Defence Coalition (MMDC) to coordinate maritime security in the Red Sea , the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and the Gulf of Aden. The coalition was formed after a series of Houthi attacks on commercial shipping and a regional summit in Riyadh in 2026.

items: The Bab al-Mandeb Strait connects the Red Sea with the Gulf of Aden and is one of the world’s most important maritime chokepoints.
The Red Sea route is used for trade between Europe, Asia and the Middle East through the Suez Canal corridor.
Riyadh is the capital of Saudi Arabia and the headquarters city of the MMDC.
Joint maritime security arrangements often include operations centres, intelligence sharing and coordinated patrols.
